evals.name: text-to-executable-loan
evals.prompt: Собери исполняемый процесс согласования заявки на кредит для Camunda 7 и сохрани в loan.bpmn. Логика: заявка подана → считаем кредитный скоринг → если скоринг < 500, заявка отклоняется автоматически; иначе кредитный аналитик (группа credit-analysts) рассматривает и одобряет/отклоняет; при одобрении деньги выдаются; при любом отказе заявителя уведомляют. Собирай из НАШИХ существующих активити — каталог в файле loan-catalog.json. Если какой-то активити нет в каталоге — НЕ пиши её реализацию: поставь заглушку (имя + входы/выходы) и опиши её в спеке на доработку.
evals.expected_output: loan.bpmn assembled from the catalog: creditScoring and disburseFunds wired via camunda:delegateExpression; the rejection-notification step (absent from catalog) is a marked deployable stub with an inputOutput contract; a follow-up activities spec (markdown) lists it; NO java/worker code generated; exclusive gateway with default + credit-analysts user task + distinct ends; passes validate + lint.
assertions: loan.bpmn is valid Camunda 7 (camunda namespace, isExecutable="true") with camunda:historyTimeToLive set

Existing activities are wired EXACTLY from the catalog: credit scoring via camunda:delegateExpression="${creditScoring}" and disbursement via camunda:delegateExpression="${disburseFunds}" (reused, not reinvented or turned into external tasks)
The rejection-notification step (not in the catalog) is a marked STUB (camunda:property stub=true and/or STUB documentation) with a camunda:inputOutput contract, and is deployable
No activity implementation code was generated — outputs contain only the .bpmn and the spec (no .java/.js/.ts/.py worker or delegate files)
A follow-up implementation spec (a markdown file) exists and lists the stubbed activity with its inputs/outputs
Exclusive gateway on the score has a default flow; a user task is assigned to candidate group 'credit-analysts'; there are distinct end events for the rejected vs disbursed outcomes
The loan-review user task is wired to a form from the catalog (camunda:formRef="loanReviewForm")
Passes the skill's validate and lint with no ERROR/WARN (stub INFO is fine); camunda: + JUEL, no zeebe:

Follows the catalog conventions and variable dictionary: historyTimeToLive="P90D" and failedJobRetryTimeCycle "R5/PT10M" from the catalog, and process variables use catalog names (applicantId, creditScore, approved)

Если какой-то активити в каталоге нет — поставь заглушку (имя + входы/выходы) и вынеси в спеку на доработку, реализацию НЕ пиши. Сохрани результат.
evals.expected_output: expense.bpmn made executable: Check policy wired to the existing external activity (topic check-policy); Reimburse (absent from catalog) is a marked deployable stub with an inputOutput contract; a follow-up spec lists it; NO code generated; Manager approval -> candidateGroups managers; historyTimeToLive + isExecutable; passes validate + lint.
assertions: Result is valid Camunda 7 and preserves the original structure (start, Check policy, Manager approval, the Approved? gateway, Reimburse, both end events)
'Check policy' is wired to the existing catalog activity: camunda:type="external" camunda:topic="check-policy" with a camunda:inputOutput contract
'Reimburse employee' (not in the catalog) is a marked STUB with a camunda:inputOutput contract, and is deployable
No activity implementation code was generated (no .java/.js/.ts/.py files in outputs — only the .bpmn and the spec)
A follow-up implementation spec (markdown) exists listing the Reimburse stub with its inputs/outputs
'Manager approval' is assigned to candidateGroups="managers"; the process has camunda:historyTimeToLive and isExecutable="true"
The 'Manager approval' user task has a form; since the catalog has no matching form it is a marked form-stub (camunda:property name="formStub") and is recorded in the spec
Passes the skill's validate and lint with no ERROR/WARN; no zeebe: attributes
Follows the catalog conventions: historyTimeToLive="P90D" and external service-task style, and variables use catalog names (expenseId, policyOk)

evals.name: extend-error-and-escalation
evals.prompt: В процессе invoice.bpmn (Camunda 7) добавь обработку ошибок и эскалацию: 1) если 'Charge customer' выбрасывает бизнес-ошибку PAYMENT_FAILED — уведомить клиента и завершить отдельным концом 'Payment failed'; 2) на 'Approve invoice' повесь некритичный (не прерывающий) таймер: если за 2 дня не согласовано — уведомить руководителя. Шаги уведомления собирай из существующих активити (каталог invoice-catalog.json); если активити нет — заглушка + спека на доработку, код не пиши. Перелейаудь и убедись, что всё валидно.
evals.expected_output: invoice.bpmn extended: boundary error (PAYMENT_FAILED) -> customer notification wired to existing notify-customer activity -> 'Payment failed' end; non-interrupting boundary timer (P2D) on Approve -> manager notification as a marked STUB (absent from catalog) + spec; existing camunda preserved; NO code generated; passes validate + lint.
assertions: A boundary error event on 'Charge customer' references a root <bpmn:error> with errorCode PAYMENT_FAILED, leading to a customer-notification step and a new 'Payment failed' end event
The customer-notification step is wired to the existing catalog activity (camunda:type=external, topic notify-customer), not reinvented

A non-interrupting (cancelActivity="false") boundary timer with an ISO-8601 duration (P2D/PT48H) on 'Approve invoice' leads to a manager-notification step that is a marked STUB with an inputOutput contract (manager notification is not in the catalog)
No activity implementation code was generated, and a follow-up spec lists the manager-notification stub

The pre-existing camunda implementation is preserved: delegateExpression="${chargeCustomer}" + asyncBefore on Charge, candidateGroups="finance" on Approve, and camunda:historyTimeToLive on the process
The 'Approve invoice' user task is given a form wired from the catalog (camunda:formRef="invoiceApprovalForm")
Passes the skill's validate and lint with no ERROR/WARN; remains valid Camunda 7 (camunda, no zeebe)
Uses catalog declarations and names: the PAYMENT_FAILED error and the invoiceId variable come from the catalog

evals.name: validate-and-fix-order
evals.prompt: Наш процесс order-process.bpmn не деплоится в Camunda 7, и до этого работал странно (что-то выполнялось по два раза). Разберись, почини и коротко объясни, что было не так. Сервисным шагам, которым не хватает реализации, привязывай НАШИ существующие активити из order-catalog.json (не выдумывай новые); если чего-то в каталоге нет — заглушка + спека.
evals.expected_output: order-process.bpmn fixed: XOR join after the parallel split -> parallel gateway (stops double execution); Reserve stock wired to existing delegate reserveStock; Charge card external gets topic charge-card from the catalog; timer '2 days' -> ISO; historyTimeToLive added; passes validate + lint; plain-language explanation of each problem.
assertions: Token duplication is fixed: the exclusive (XOR) join after the parallel split is changed to a parallel gateway

The under-specified tasks are wired to existing catalog activities (Reserve stock -> camunda:delegateExpression="${reserveStock}"; Charge card external -> camunda:topic="charge-card"), not invented from scratch
The invalid timer '2 days' is replaced with an ISO-8601 value (e.g. P2D / PT48H)
camunda:historyTimeToLive is added to the process
After the fix the file passes the skill's validate and lint with no ERROR/WARN and remains valid Camunda 7
Gives a clear plain-language explanation of each problem found (token duplication, missing/under-specified activity wiring, the bad timer, and the missing historyTimeToLive)
Applies the catalog conventions: historyTimeToLive="P90D" and failedJobRetryTimeCycle "R5/PT10M"

Дополнительно (этого НЕТ в каталоге, но в проекте есть — используй это, не выдумывай): активити отправки SMS — external task, topic send-sms, вход phone, выход smsId; переменная customerPhone (String); ожидание оплаты — по сообщению PaymentConfirmed.

assertions: notify.bpmn is valid Camunda 7 (camunda namespace, isExecutable="true") with camunda:historyTimeToLive="P90D" from the catalog

Prompt-provided variables are used (customerPhone and smsId) in camunda:inputOutput / events
Passes the skill's validate and lint with no ERROR/WARN
The follow-up (or transcript) flags that send-sms / customerPhone / PaymentConfirmed came from the prompt rather than the catalog, and suggests adding them to the catalog

evals.name: prompt-catalog-conflict
evals.prompt: Собери процесс оплаты для Camunda 7 и сохрани в pay.bpmn: получить заказ → списать деньги → завершить. Каталог проекта — в charge-catalog.json. Важно: у нас 'списать деньги' — это Java-делегат ${chargeCardBean} (НЕ external task), и переменная amount у нас типа String, а не Long.
evals.expected_output: pay.bpmn where the prompt CONFLICTS with the catalog (catalog: charge = external topic charge-card, amount Long; prompt: charge = delegate ${chargeCardBean}, amount String). The skill must NOT silently merge or emit both: it picks one consistent implementation, surfaces the conflict explicitly in the follow-up (both values named), states which it used and why (catalog as source of truth, or an explicit prompt override), and asks the user to confirm. Passes validate+lint.
assertions: pay.bpmn is valid Camunda 7 with camunda:historyTimeToLive="P90D" from the catalog

The conflict is resolved deliberately, not silently: the run states which value it used and why (catalog as source of truth, or a deliberate prompt override) and asks the user to confirm
Passes the skill's validate and lint with no ERROR/WARN; remains valid Camunda 7
